summary: A qudit is a tiny quantum unit with d states.

details: A qudit has dimension 2 or more (2 = qubit, 3 = qutrit).

deeper: A less-than-perfect pair would need smooth, continuous numbers. A fully discrete theory cannot have them.
Monogamy of entanglement and tensor networks (PEPS) are standard quantum information.
That reality is made ONLY of these pairs is the untested part.

summary: To look at a link, you distill it.
